record.bible_text: If a man<WH0376> shall steal<WH01589><WTH8799> an ox<WH07794>, or a sheep<WH07716>, and kill<WH02873><WTH8804> it, or sell<WH04376><WTH8804> it; he shall restore<WH07999><WTH8762> five<WH02568> oxen<WH01241> for an ox<WH07794>, and four<WH0702> sheep<WH06629> for a sheep<WH07716>. <RF>or a sheep: or, or a goat<Rf>
